title: BHARAT MAPS Public-service Buildings — Assam Revenue Circles
description: Count of health centres and schools per Revenue Circle in Assam, sourced from the BHARAT MAPS GIS service, used as a public-service-building exposure input to the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk model.
purpose: Public-service-building exposure covariate for the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk score model.
details: This is a snapshot as of September 2023, not a time series. License confirmed as 'CC BY 4.0' per the risk model's data dictionary. Note: that dictionary classifies health_centres_count and schools_count under its own 'Vulnerability' pillar (not 'Exposure') — IDS-DRR's own Hazard/Exposure/Vulnerability/Government-Response taxonomy is a composite-risk-index framework distinct from RDLS's hazard/exposure/vulnerability/loss object types, and the two should not be assumed to align 1:1; 'exposure' is used here because these are physical assets located in a hazard-prone area, which is RDLS's own definition of exposure. Road and rail infrastructure from the same source are catalogued separately in Sources/BHARATMAPS/metadata/rdls-infrastructure.json, since RDLS's exposure object takes a single 'category' per dataset and roads/rail belong to 'infrastructure' rather than 'buildings'.

gazetteer_entries.description: Assam Revenue Circles administrative boundaries (the object_id used across IDS-DRR variables) — a custom scheme, not yet a registered RDLS gazetteer.
